purpose: Propose which currently available resource classes deserve emphasis for one selected activity mode. The proposal is bounded to observed available resources and does not change scheduling, clocks, services, network policy, display settings, or hardware state.
principles: resource policy begins as a proposal
never propose resources that were not observed as available
activity mode does not itself grant actuation authority
general mode preserves a balanced available set
user and safety constraints remain independent gates
